analysis.executive_summary: AMD delivered strong annual revenue growth in 2025, driven by the performance of our Data Center and Client and Gaming segments. We continue to execute our AI strategy, investing in software capabilities and the open ecosystem. However, we face risks related to highly competitive and rapidly evolving markets, highly cyclical semiconductor industry, and dependence on significant customers. We also face challenges related to inventory and related charges associated with U.S. government export control on AMD Instinct™ MI308 Data Center GPU products and potential impact of U.S. government regulations on revenue generated from licensed MI308 sales to China.

key_risks.title: Highly competitive and rapidly evolving markets
key_risks.description: The markets in which our products are sold are highly competitive and rapidly evolving.

key_risks.title: Highly cyclical semiconductor industry
key_risks.description: The semiconductor industry is highly cyclical and has experienced severe downturns.

key_risks.title: Dependence on significant customers
key_risks.description: The loss of a significant customer may have a material adverse effect on us.

key_risks.title: Intellectual property protection
key_risks.description: If we cannot adequately protect our technology or other intellectual property through patents, copyrights, trade secrets, trademarks and other measures, we may lose a competitive advantage and incur significant expenses.

key_risks.title: Cybersecurity risks
key_risks.description: Our products may be subject to security vulnerabilities that could have a material adverse effect on us.

growth_opportunities.title: Growing demand for AI infrastructure
growth_opportunities.description: The growth of AI is further creating pressure on the semiconductor industry to timely design, manufacture and deliver semiconductor products and solutions to meet customer demand for computing power and AI infrastructure.

growth_opportunities.title: Increasing adoption of cloud computing
growth_opportunities.description: The development of the legal and regulatory environment relating to emerging technologies such as AI is expected to have implications for our business.

growth_opportunities.title: Growing demand for high-performance computing
growth_opportunities.description: Our high-performance product portfolios provide differentiated solutions, including semi-custom System-on-Chip (SoCs), adaptive SoCs and accelerated processing units (APUs).

financial_insights.observation: Revenue increased 34% to $34.6 billion in 2025 compared to $25.8 billion in 2024.
financial_insights.interpretation: The increase in revenue is driven by strong demand for our Data Center and Client and Gaming segments.

financial_insights.observation: Gross margin of 50% increased by 1% compared to 49% in 2024.
financial_insights.interpretation: The increase in gross margin is primarily due to product mix partially offset by approximately $440 million of net inventory and related charges associated with the U.S. government export control on AMD Instinct™ MI308 Data Center GPU products.

management_priorities: Accelerating growth in the Data Center segment
Continuing to invest in software capabilities and the open ecosystem

Increasing adoption of cloud computing and AI infrastructure
